name: app-solution-statement-with-soft-yellow-gradient-tile-and-tilted-home-screen
title: Solution statement card with a soft yellow gradient tile and a tilted dark home screen
whatItIs: A warm grey rounded panel with a small caps label and a large sans statement about an assistant balancing chores and rest, a small side paragraph, and two tiles below: an orange-yellow soft gradient and a black phone corner showing the app icon among Photos, Mail and Notes.
whatItMeans: Warm and trustworthy; the sunny gradient stands for calm while the icon proves it exists.
techniques: Pair a big statement with a small right-aligned explainer.
Show a pure gradient tile as mood.
Crop the phone home screen to show the icon in context.

vocabulary.definition: An app icon among real icons.
A small paragraph at the right of a big statement.
